character: large male jaguar, spotted coat, condescending lazy predator, same character every shot, no costume changes
props: raw meat on the sand, visible in every frame; capybara pushing a wooden cart, wheel stuck in mud, cart always in motion
motion_rule: jaguar crosses the frame to a new spot every window, never speaks from one place; camera always moving, shot size changes every window; capybara stays large, close to the lens
environment: open sandy riverbank at the jungle edge, bright midday sun, hard direct shadows, no dark thicket

audio.delivery: lazy, condescending, low male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: po-zhir-NEY, pri-DYOT-sa, a-HO-tit-sa, MAR-ke-te — the stress is HO in the hunting word, never a-ho-TIT-sa
audio.pacing: even pace, words fit each window with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: his mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, jaw shaping the words, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: claws on bark, water splash, cart wheel in mud

timeline.a: jaguar runs along a branch over water, far end to center, claws on bark; raw meat already lies on the open sand below; capybara pushes cart along the water
scrambles further along the branch toward the water, paw pushes a fern aside; capybara pulls cart, rear wheel stuck in mud
moves along the branch toward the lens, tail swaying; capybara steps through the mud
jumps off the branch onto a root, lands softly on four paws; capybara stretches its neck toward the meat
body drops low and drags the meat further across the open sand toward himself; cart tips sideways
slides off the root onto the sand, shakes its head in the sun; capybara clings to the tilting cart
walks along the sand beside the water toward the lens; capybara rights the cart, steps toward the meat
reaches the meat, covers it with a paw while still moving; capybara at the lens reaches for the meat and misses
jaguar circles a full loop around the meat, herding the capybara back; capybara reaches again and misses
jaguar drives the capybara along the water toward the lens, both crossing the frame; cart splashes through shallow water
jaguar leaps onto the root, springs back down beside the meat, arcing through the air; capybara reaches and misses again
jaguar surges through shallow water in a fan of spray, side to side across the frame; capybara backs the cart from the splash
jaguar bursts toward the lens and swerves past it, spotted flank filling the frame; capybara pushes cart, wheel spinning in mud
meat large on the sand under the jaguar's paw; capybara huge at the lens pushing her empty cart right past the camera

must_appear: meat visible on sand every window; jaguar crosses to a new spot every window; capybara close to the lens, reaching for the meat and missing
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, lamp, dim, moody, low key, candle, neon, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, a vertical pillar in one place, only his head moving, speaking from one spot, standing still over the meat, meat carried away, empty sand with no meat, English speech, foreign accent, Latin letters, any word after 6.3, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, multiple characters, character changing mid-shot
